notes: SUCCESS BAR MET on Fedora 44 / RTX 4080. AH-64D Instant Action: main menu, mission entered, airborne and flyable 60s+ with no crash. Required the IC-safe Segoe font patch; without it the Apache dies on mission entry with C0000005 ACCESS_VIOLATION in CockpitBase.dll. Cockpit symbology (EUFD, MFD, HMD, KU) renders correctly with a DejaVu substitute -- Microsoft's seguisym.ttf is NOT required. TADS/PNVS sight not exercised, so the MFD/sight texture conversion patch remains UNTESTED. MFD_LCD_AH64_* 'texture not found' errors are runtime render-target names, not shipped files, and the MFDs render correctly despite them.
